Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

history — events of the past. Example: The invention changed history.
century — one hundred years. Example: In the nineteenth century there was a war.
war — fighting between countries. Example: The war ended in 1945.
king — a male royal ruler. Example: A king lived in the castle.
queen — a female royal ruler. Example: The queen was very popular.
invention — something new that someone makes. Example: The invention of the telephone changed life.
discover — to find something for the first time. Example: People discovered fire long ago.
event — an organised occasion. Example: It was a big event.
past — the time before now. Example: I talk about the past.
ago — before now. Example: It happened a hundred years ago.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• In the ... century ...
• There was a ...
• It happened ... years ago.
• It changed history.
• It was a big event.
